latest_news.headline: Proposed Hormuz deal would give Iran control of inbound traffic, but reopening is not imminent
latest_news.title: Proposed Hormuz deal would give Iran control of inbound traffic, but reopening is not imminent
latest_news.text: Reuters reports negotiations are moving forward and route parameters are understood, while regional sources say key control and fee details remain unresolved. Hormuz controlled traffic remains limited rather than physically reopened.
latest_news.summary: Reuters sources say the draft would grant Tehran control of Gulf-bound shipping, with outbound control and fees unresolved; regional sources pushed back on claims of an imminent reopening.

latest_news.headline: Israel orders Mansouri evacuation and strikes southern Lebanon during Rome talks
latest_news.title: Israel orders Mansouri evacuation and strikes southern Lebanon during Rome talks
latest_news.text: AP reports strikes despite the ceasefire after Israel ordered residents of Mansouri to evacuate; Lebanon says one person was killed and 12 wounded in Tebnine. Negotiations in Rome continued the same day.
latest_news.summary: The first evacuation warning in weeks was followed by strikes; the casualty report and same-day talks reconfirm both ceasefire_violation and diplomacy_active.

latest_news.headline: Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi oil tanker off Yanbu
latest_news.title: Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi oil tanker off Yanbu
latest_news.text: Reuters reports the Houthi claim; Saudi officials had not confirmed the incident or damage by cutoff. The report follows a projectile attack that sank an Indian-flagged vessel near Yemen.
latest_news.summary: Claimed missile attack adds to already severe Red Sea maritime disruption; attribution and damage remain unconfirmed by Saudi authorities.

latest_news.headline: Russian ballistic-missile barrage kills at least 15 around Kyiv
latest_news.title: Russian ballistic-missile barrage kills at least 15 around Kyiv
latest_news.text: AP reports 14 killed in the Kyiv region and one in the capital, with 42 wounded; Reuters later reported a toll of 17. No configured nuclear or direct-NATO threshold was verified.
latest_news.summary: The strike reinforces the active-war ceiling but does not activate a canonical nuclear or NATO signal.

latest_news.title: Ukraine says North Korean missile unit is deploying to western Russia; Reuters cannot independently verify
latest_news.summary: Ukrainian intelligence says a roughly 90-person unit is deploying to Voronezh and could eventually receive 120 ballistic missiles and six launchers. Moscow and Pyongyang did not respond; no canonical signal was activated on a single unverified claim.

latest_news.title: Taiwan begins annual 10-day Han Kuang exercise focused on decentralized command and resilience
latest_news.summary: More than 20,000 troops are involved in defensive drills including dispersal, relocation and degraded-internet scenarios. No fresh Chinese blockade, attack or deployment threshold was verified.

latest_news.title: Israel-Lebanon Rome talks continue without a new withdrawal agreement
latest_news.summary: The second day of talks continued on withdrawal, pilot zones and Hezbollah weapons, but a Lebanese official said Beirut had received no Israeli political answer on ceasefire commitments and no further pullback was expected yet.

latest_news.title: Russian ballistic missile waves trigger fires in Kyiv and warehouse districts
latest_news.summary: Kyiv officials reported waves of ballistic missiles, building fires and air-defence activity. The event reinforces active conventional war but did not cross a configured nuclear or direct-NATO threshold.

latest_news.title: Indian-flagged vessel sinks near Yemen after projectile strike; all 14 aboard rescued
latest_news.summary: The ship capsized and sank near Yemen. Yemen blamed the Houthis, but no independently confirmed attribution or distinct new configured signal threshold was established.

latest_news.title: Myanmar opposition umbrella body signals openness to talks, but junta has not accepted it as interlocutor
latest_news.summary: Analysts describe a possible move toward talks about talks rather than a peace process. Auto-detection review did not add a new zone because this is an existing civil war with tentative diplomacy, not a newly emerging interstate or nuclear crisis.

latest_news.headline: Hormuz traffic stays near-blockade levels: eight Tuesday transits versus 130-140 pre-war
latest_news.summary: Kpler counted five tankers and three bulk carriers through Hormuz, unchanged day/day; Bab el-Mandeb held at 20. Qatar described mediation progress, while Iran disputed that talks were already under way.

latest_news.headline: Kim Yo Jong warns of additional military options over Japan Tomahawk capability
latest_news.source: Reuters / KCNA via The Straits Times
latest_news.summary: The official warning raises the near-term test watch but did not report a missile launch or nuclear test and therefore does not activate a canonical signal.

latest_news.headline: UN OCHA: Gaza remains unsafe as attacks hit homes and learning spaces
latest_news.summary: OCHA reported a student shot in a tented classroom, demolition of homes and Beit Lahia's last remaining school, and further restricted-area expansion; it cited 1,209 deaths since the October ceasefire.

latest_news.headline: JMIC rates Hormuz severe as tanker traffic stays far below baseline and mine risk persists
latest_news.title: JMIC rates Hormuz severe as tanker traffic stays far below baseline and mine risk persists
latest_news.summary: UKMTO/JMIC said independent tracking showed single-digit tanker movements in both directions, while 30 U.S.-facilitated transits occurred over 2–3 August against a historical average of about 138 vessels per day. It reported increased IRGC attacks and harassment, active mine-danger areas, and deliberate hostile action as highly likely. The official advisory reconfirms existing canonical signals; it does not establish a new probability threshold.

latest_news.headline: Houthi-claimed drone strike suspends operations at Saudi Najran Airport
latest_news.title: Houthi-claimed drone strike suspends operations at Saudi Najran Airport
latest_news.summary: Reuters reported the Houthi claim of a drone strike on a target at Najran Airport, while Saudi Arabia had not confirmed it. AFP separately cited a regional source saying operations were suspended after the airport’s main radar was hit. The incident reconfirms the canonical infrastructure_strike signal; attribution and damage still lack Saudi official confirmation.
latest_news.source: Reuters; AFP via Times of Israel
